title: Compute node loses power mid-job
teaches: SlurmdTimeout is the price of not false-alarming: jobs sit on a dead node until it expires. Requeue-safe jobs come back elsewhere; the rest end NODE_FAIL.
error: timed out: slurm-c2 back in service by itself (ReturnToService=1)

next_steps: Check whether the host is reachable at all.
If it is, restart slurmd; running jobs survive a slurmd restart.
If the host is gone, the jobs are already lost. Let the timeout mark it DOWN and follow the down-node path.

next_steps: Check the host: power, console, network reachability.
If the host is up, check slurmd (status, journal) and restart it.
With ReturnToService=1 the node rejoins by itself once slurmd registers; otherwise resume it explicitly.
